top_signal.title: Looking for custom business squishies/fidget toys...where should I buy?
top_signal.summary: Me and my nonprofit just started up a small company store and we had our first go around at an event. It went great and we got good sales, but I realized a great selling point for much of our audience would be items for kids that weren't so professional. I know NeeDohs and other squishies are a big craze, but Staples (who we originally ordered from) doesn't have a selection I am a fan of and everywhere else I look doesn't have many reviews. Any recommendations?       submitted by     /u/GooseMan428       [link]       [comments]
